v1.6.0 What's new? -
+New drone assembly mechanic
+New lobby
+New missiles
-Fixed a bug with the display of donors on the leaderboard
-It is no longer possible to end the round early in "Free For All" mode
-etc.

Drone Impact is a game featuring two teams: defenders and attackers.

Attackers. Your objective: attack the defenders base using various drones and environments. 

Defenders. Your objective: use machine guns, pistols, and electronic warfare systems to repel the drone attacks.

Disclaimer: All events, objects, and equipment in the game are fictional. The game is not related to real-world geopolitical events and was created solely for entertainment purposes.
